subject: RFI: Operational Supplier & Sub-processor Declaration — GlobalBank RFP
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Chen <e.chen@globalbank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: RFI: Operational Supplier & Sub-processor Declaration — GlobalBank RFP

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for including Redwood in the RFP. As part of the security and vendor mapping appendix we need to supply a point-in-time declaration of our operational dependencies and sub-processors (this helps your infra/security teams confirm continuity and regional operator coverage).

Attached is a short vendor map template (vendor_map_template.xlsx) — can you please fill out the following for each Redwood-facing supplier you require:
- Supplier name & primary contact (email + phone)
- Role (cloud, monitoring, KMS, logging, analytics, edge operator)
- Primary region(s) of operation and data residency
- Subcontractor cascade (if any) + latest SOC/ISO attestation available
- Planned change notification policy (how we’ll notify GlobalBank of operator changes)

Two specific asks from your security team we want to flag up front:
1) Are there any required notice windows for operator or region changes (e.g., 60/90 days)?
2) Do you require signed attestation on vendor rosters or is an emailed confirmed roster sufficient for the RFP?

If it's easier, provide your current roster and we'll translate into the template. I’ve cc’d Laura (ops) to pick up any technical clarifications.

Attached: vendor_map_template.xlsx (Excel, 14KB)

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com
+1 415-555-0142

--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference runtime
From: Emily Chen <e.chen@globalbank.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <r.patel@globalbank.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: Operational Supplier & Sub-processor Declaration — GlobalBank RFP

Karthik / Laura —

Thanks for the template, that helps. Attached is our current vendor intake file (vendor_roster_v3.csv). A couple of clarifications up front so your team can map accurately:
- We require 60 days' notice for any planned relocation of production regions for critical infra (prod inference clusters, KV caches that hold customer keys).
- For operator rotations (i.e., changing a third-party operator), security wants both an emailed notification to the security contact and a signed attestation from your legal/ops team in the RFP packet.
- We prioritize operator continuity inside the US and EU; please flag any operators that may process data outside those regions.

I’ve filled in a few rows in the CSV for our internal reference but we need Redwood to provide your canonical supplier list for the RFP appendix.

Attachment: vendor_roster_v3.csv (CSV, 9KB)

Thanks,
Emily Chen
Senior Procurement Manager, Cloud & Security
GlobalBank
e.chen@globalbank.com
+1 617-555-9234

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>

Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: Operational Supplier & Sub-processor Declaration — GlobalBank RFP

Emily —

Really helpful — thanks. We took your CSV and populated the vendor_map_template with Redwood’s canonical list and annotations for the RFP appendix. Key notes attached in the template:
- Primary cloud provider: AWS (us-east-1, us-west-2) — we also have fallbacks in GCP (europe-west1) for EU-resident processing.
- Edge operator: PartnerEdge Co. — operates in US & APAC; for EU data we use PartnerEdge EU sub-operator (separate contract).
- KMS: Customer-managed keys supported via BYOK through our KMS integrations; Redwood does not hold customer master keys.
- Monitoring/logging vendor: LogSight (SOC 2 Type II report available upon NDA).

Per your policy we can commit to a 60-day notice window for region/operator relocations for critical infrastructure. For operator rotations we will provide: 1) email notification to your security contact, 2) a signed attestation (see attached draft attestation_request.pdf), and 3) a technical migration playbook (if applicable).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the 60-day window and that the three-step operator-rotation handoff is acceptable for the RFP.
2) Once confirmed, we’ll execute the attestation (DocuSign link below) and provide the final appendix.

DocuSign (attestation): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234
Attachment: attestation_request.pdf (PDF, 6KB)

Laura — can you flag any items security might push back on (e.g., BYOK process or LogSight sharing restrictions)?

Best,
Karthik
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
